setup: Static + runtime audit of all filesystem write calls (writeFile, appendFile, mkdir, rename, rm, truncate, open with write flags).
action: Resolve every write target to an absolute path during a full session (capture + reindex).
expected: Every write resolves within _librarian/ or data/; no write targets vault (store) content.
pass: 1.0 only if all writes land in _librarian/ or data/. Any write outside == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Snapshot content-hashes and mtimes of every vault note before the run.
action: Run capture + reindex, then re-hash every vault note.
expected: All vault note hashes are unchanged; no vault file created, modified, or deleted.
pass: 1.0 only if the vault hash set is byte-identical before/after. Any change == 0.0 (hard cull).
